map.疫苗/驱虫到期提醒系统 使用指南: Vaccination / Deworming Due Date Reminder System User Guide
map.为犬猫建立健康档案，内置疫苗免疫与驱虫周期自动计算下次到期日并颜色预警，帮助宠主: Build a health record for each dog or cat, with vaccine and deworming cycles built in to calculate the next due date automatically and raise a colour alert, so owners keep up with immunisation and deworming without gaps.
map.为每只宠物建立健康档案（生日、上次疫苗/驱虫日期、间隔周期），自动算出下次到期日: Keep a health record for each pet (birthday, the date of the last vaccination or deworming, the interval) and it works out the next due date automatically and reminds you.
map.幼犬猫按周龄管理首免节奏（如疫苗间隔 21 天、体内驱虫每 30 天），避免漏打: For puppies and kittens, manage the first immunisation schedule by age in weeks (such as a 21 day vaccine interval and deworming every 30 days) so nothing is missed.
map.多宠家庭统一查看到期清单，导出记录便于就诊时出示。: A multi-pet household sees a unified due list, and the exported record is handy to show at the vet.
map.示例：下次到期计算: Example: calculating the next due date
map.：逻辑：下次到期 = 上次日期 + 间隔天数。幼犬首免 2026-01-01、间: Logic: next due = last date + interval days. A puppy's first immunisation on 2026-01-01 with a 21 day interval is next due 2026-01-22; deworming every 30 days from 2026-01-01 is next due 2026-01-31. Age in weeks = (today − birthday) ÷ 7, used to judge the first immunisation window. The data is stored in the local browser and not uploaded.
map.宠物诊疗辅助流程: Pet Diagnosis and Treatment Auxiliary Workflow
map.数据存在哪里？安全吗？: Where is the data stored? Is it secure?
map.仅保存在本机浏览器 localStorage，纯前端运行、不上传服务器；换设备或: Stored only in your browser's localStorage, running purely in the front end with nothing uploaded to a server; changing device or clearing the cache loses it, so export a backup regularly.
map.间隔天数怎么定？: How do I choose the interval days?
map.按疫苗/驱虫说明书与兽医建议设定（如核心疫苗首免 2–4 周间隔、体内驱虫幼龄每: Set it from the vaccination and deworming instructions and the vet's advice (such as a 2-4 week interval for the first core vaccine, monthly deworming for the young and every 3 months for adults). The tool only does the date arithmetic and does not replace a vaccination schedule, so follow your vet's plan.
